description:
Vital Recorder is open on the Windows desktop showing an empty workspace. Two real intraoperative vital signs recordings from the VitalDB open dataset (Seoul National University Hospital) are available at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\VitalRecorderData\: case 0001.vital (a ~3-hour noncardiac surgery with arterial pressure, ECG, pulse oximetry, capnography, and anesthetic agent monitoring) and case 0002.vital (a ~4-hour noncardiac surgery with ECG, pulse oximetry, heart rate, ST segment, and ventilator parameters).

As part of a retrospective case review, you need to:
1. Export case 0001 vital signs data to CSV format, saved as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\case_0001_data.csv
2. Export case 0002 vital signs data to CSV format, saved as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\case_0002_data.csv
3. Create a comparison summary text file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\case_comparison.txt that documents the key differences between the two cases: recording duration, which physiological tracks are available in each case, and any notable differences in the surgical event timeline (case start, surgery start, surgery finish, case finish).

Login: Desktop user (no login required for Vital Recorder).
